page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-4 is an Arm-based instance configured with an elevated ratio of system memory to virtual processor capacity. The machine features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 architecture alongside 32.0 GB of RAM, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core. This memory-dense profile accommodates memory-heavy tasks without requiring the provisioning of excessive compute cycles.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, depending entirely on network-attached block storage for system and application disks. It also operates without hardware acceleration, featuring zero discrete GPUs, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses in the baseline configuration. This lean hardware composition keeps resource overhead focused strictly on memory density and core Arm processing efficiency.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the n4a-highmem-4 is suited for workloads that require significant working memory while maintaining moderate CPU consumption. Typical applications include in-memory caching solutions, operational databases, data processing pipelines, ETL transformations, and containerized backend services running on 64-bit Arm infrastructure.
